title: This Shark Hunts With a Whip Half as Long as Its Body
subject: thresher shark

scenes.text: This shark hunts with a whip, not its teeth.
Its tail makes up about half of its whole body length.
It swings that tail through a 180-degree arc in about a third of a second.
Researchers filmed it off the Philippines. One strike can knock out up to seven sardines.
Then the shark circles back and eats the stunned ones. Sharks ate 3.5 sardines on average per hunt.
So the sardines aren't caught by a bite. They're hit by the tail.

description:
This shark hunts with a whip, not its teeth.
A thresher shark's tail is about half its body length, and one slap can stun several sardines.
Which ocean hunter amazes you most?
